Passive. Senea's normal attacks mesmerize enemies on hit for [[8]]s, reducing their ATK by [[10%]]. When a mesmerized enemy is defeated, they turn into a spectral spectator. Senea can have up to 5 spectral spectators.
Active. Upon reaching 1,000 Energy, Senea consumes [[200]] Energy to begin an impassioned performance. During the performance, Senea gains [[120]] ATK SPD and automatically casts her normal attacks at her current attack rate. Each of these normal attacks consumes [[100]] Energy, though this cost decreases as her ATK SPD and Haste increase. These attacks also deal extra true damage equal to [[8%]] of the target's max HP and inflict [[max HP Reduction|hpCut]] equal to [[100%]]<ATK>. The extra true damage cannot exceed [[140%]]<ATK>. The performance ends when Senea's Energy is depleted.
While Senea's Ultimate is active, increases the extra true damage dealt by each normal attack to [[9%]] of the target's max HP. This extra true damage cannot exceed [[150%]]<ATK>.
While Senea's Ultimate is active, increases the extra true damage dealt by each normal attack to [[10%]] of the target's max HP. This extra true damage cannot exceed [[160%]]<ATK>.
While Senea's Ultimate is active, increases the extra true damage dealt by each normal attack to [[11%]] of the target's max HP. This extra true damage cannot exceed [[170%]]<ATK>.
While Senea's Ultimate is active, increases the extra true damage dealt by each normal attack to [[12%]] of the target's max HP. This extra true damage cannot exceed [[180%]]<ATK>.

Senea launches [[1]] extra projectile with each normal attack. Whenever she receives a temporary stat buff from an ally, the number of extra projectiles increases by [[1]], up to a maximum of [[5]]. Each ally can trigger this effect only once. After Senea hits an enemy with a normal attack projectile, that enemy takes [[25%]] less damage from projectiles launched by her subsequent normal attacks.
Active. Senea performs a special normal attack, replacing the projectiles with [[2]] musical notes, each dealing [[150%]]<ATK> damage.
Increases the damage dealt by each musical note to [[160%]]<ATK> when this skill is used actively.
Increases the damage dealt by each musical note to [[170%]]<ATK> when this skill is used actively.
Increases the damage dealt by each musical note to [[180%]]<ATK> when this skill is used actively.

Senea sings a brilliant melody, sending sound waves across the battlefield that deal [[170%]]<ATK> damage to all enemies [[3]] times. If there are any spectral spectators on the battlefield, each one scatters petals in time with the music, restoring [[50]] Energy and [[100%]]<ATK> HP to Senea.
Increases the impact damage to [[180%]]<ATK>.
Increases the impact damage to [[190%]]<ATK>.
Increases the impact damage to [[200%]]<ATK>.
Increases ATK by [[9%]] during battle, and by an extra [[6%]] when 3 spectral spectators are present.
Increases ATK by [[12%]] during battle, and by an extra [[8%]] when 3 spectral spectators are present.
Increases ATK by [[15%]] during battle, and by an extra [[10%]] when 3 spectral spectators are present.

For every [[3]] normal attacks Senea unleashes during Grave Crescendo, she attracts 1 extra spectral spectator. Once Senea has at least [[3]] spectral spectators, a stage rises beneath her and she begins a solo performance, remaining [[steadfast|stable]] throughout. During the solo performance, each time she lands [[15]] normal attack hits, every spectral spectator on the battlefield throws a rose at her current target. Each rose deals [[190%]]<ATK> true damage.
Increases the true damage dealt by each spectral spectator's rose to [[195%]]<ATK>.

If defeated during her solo performance, Senea enters spirit form. While under control effects or in spirit form, she continues to use normal attacks, but they deal [[15%]] less damage with [[30]] less ATK SPD.
Increases the true damage dealt by each spectral spectator's rose to [[200%]]<ATK>.

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, each normal attack increases ATK SPD by [[2]] and normal attack damage by [[1%]], stacking up to [[10]] times.
Refine 4: In Rivalry Mode, increases 20 ATK SPD, 20 Execution.

d: Senea immediately attracts [[2]] spectral spectators when a battle starts.
